reels.caption:
The glamping tent is here, and it's everything we hoped it would be 🏕️
Picture this: You arrive Friday afternoon, set your bags down in a tent that's already set up for you—real bed, soft blankets, string lights overhead. You grab a drink, wander down to say hello to the Highland cow, then settle in by your private fire pit as the sun sets over the farm.
Saturday morning you wake up slow, make coffee, and spend the day however you want—explore Charleston, hang out with the animals, read a book in your camp chair, take a nap. No agenda. No rush.
This is what Outside Inn was built for. The kind of stay where you actually feel different when you leave.
Book your couples getaway through the link in bio. We're ready when you are.
